card.text: XO-3 b was found in 2007 by XO as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "XO-3b"
sources.quote: XO-3b is an exoplanet with about 11.79 times the mass of Jupiter, and it orbits its parent star XO-3 in about 3.2 days.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around XO-3. Its orbit and size follow Rusznak et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
